items.text: Growth and Exit Plan · Why it matters
A sale is one of four paths. Most owners price only one.
Keep building, buy a competitor, take a capital partner, or sell. Each path has a price, and the price of each depends on the same earnings. The plan works all four against your own numbers.
Owners with a written transition plan
In the 2023 national survey of 1,162 owners. The rest will decide the path when a buyer, a partner or a lender forces the decision.
Engagements that died on the valuation gap
Share of investment bankers’ engagements that did not close on the gap between the owner’s price and the market’s. Pepperdine, 2024.
Rollover equity, share of enterprise value
The average in private equity deals through the third quarter of 2025. A sale is often a partnership with a different name.
Deals with an earnout, 2025
Across private-target deals; 35 percent of deals under $25 million. The path you choose decides how much of the price is cash.

sections.name: Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.

items.text: Growth and Exit Plan · Questions
Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.
How is this different from the Pre-Market Assessment?

The assessment gives you a valuation range and the earnings behind it. The plan starts from that read and works out all four paths against your numbers: who would buy, what raises the price, and what each path needs first. Four to six weeks.
Do I have to choose a path at the end?
No. The plan is yours to keep. A decision session at the end walks through the four, and you decide, then or later.
Who would buy it?
The buyer types active in your sector, from the criteria buyers keep on file with Capital Row. No buyer hears about you without your written permission.
What if the answer is that I should not sell?
Then the plan says so, with the path that returns more. We will not promise a price and we will not recommend a sale the numbers do not support.
Decide with the numbers in front of you.
A sale is one of four paths. The Growth and Exit Plan shows you all four, worked against your own earnings, before you choose.
Request a Growth and Exit Plan
Scope is agreed in writing before any work begins. Nothing from your plan reaches a buyer, or anyone else, without your written permission.
